b1-unit-57.57.1 Three emergency calls:
Narrator: Dialogue one.
Operator: Nine one one, what's your emergency?
Carol: I want to report a fire. There's smoke coming from my neighbor's garage.
Operator: What's the address?
Carol: Forty-two Palm Street. It's across from the park.
Operator: Is anyone inside the house?
Carol: I don't think so. Their car isn't there. But there might be a dog inside.
Operator: OK. Stay away from the smoke, and make sure everyone on the street stays back. Firefighters are on their way.
Carol: Thank you!
Narrator: Dialogue two.
Operator: Police department. How can I help you?
Carol: I'd like to report a break-in. Someone has broken into my car.
Operator: When did it happen?
Carol: Sometime this afternoon. I parked at the mall at two, and when I came back, the window was broken.
Operator: Was anything stolen?
Carol: Yes, my sunglasses and a bag with my laptop. There wasn't anything else in the car.
Operator: Is anyone hurt?
Carol: No, everyone's fine.
Operator: OK, ma'am. We'll send an officer. There'll be someone there in about twenty minutes. Please don't touch anything.
Narrator: Dialogue three.
Operator: Nine one one, what's your emergency?
Carol: We need an ambulance right away! There's been an accident on the highway.
Operator: Can you tell me exactly where you are?
Carol: On the highway, just after the airport exit, going north.
Operator: Can you see if anyone is hurt?
Carol: One of the drivers seems to be unconscious. And there might be someone trapped in the back seat. I can't quite see.
Operator: OK, ma'am. Don't move anyone. I'm sending an ambulance and a fire truck right now.
Carol: Please hurry!
